# 真一金丹訣

**ID:** KR5a0232
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0232

## Authors / Editors
- 王常

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short Sòng *nèidān* 內丹 treatise of nine folios in one *juàn*, preserved in the *Zhèngtǒng Dàozàng* 正統道藏 (DZ 0231 / CT 231 = TC 230), 洞真部 方法類, with an appended *Tāixī jiéyào* 胎息節要 ("Essentials of Embryonic Respiration"). The work is a spurious composition attributed in its opening narrative to the lineage Zhōnglí Quán 鍾離權 → Lǚ Dòngbīn 呂洞賓 → Shī Jiānwú 施肩吾, with an elaborate framing tale that Wáng Cháng 王常 traces the transmission of the text and states that it was hidden in a cave by Shī Jiānwú. The compiler's name appears in the body of the text as "Sòng Wáng Cháng jí" 宋王常集.

**Abstract**

Farzeen Baldrian-Hussein, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 2:840 (§3.A.5, Alchemy), identifies the work as a spurious treatise attributed to Zhōnglí Quán, Lǚ Dòngbīn, and Shī Jiānwú. The text is divided into two main sections. The first comprises poems on the three methods of the *Yīnfú jīng* 陰符經 (the *qīngxū* 清虛, the *fùguó ān mín* 富國安民, and the *qiángbīng zhànshèng* 強兵戰勝 ways), followed by a short essay on the circulation of *qì* through various points of the body. The nomenclature and the theory are similar to the Zhōng Lǚ texts of the Northern Sòng (compare *[DZ 1017 Dàoshū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c1017)* 19.9a ff). The second section, *Tāixī jiéyào* 胎息節要 ("Essentials of Embryonic Respiration"), is devoted to that specific topic. A passage on 7a is quoted at *[DZ 826 Zhūzhēn shèngtāi shényòng jué](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0826)* 2b under the heading *Yùqì fǎ* 玉氣法; another paragraph on 7b is a quotation from [YJQQ](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c1032) 59.10b. The frontmatter brackets the work broadly within the Sòng (960–1279).
